pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #14
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the best way to respond when someone teases you about your appearance? (1 mark)
   A. Stop going to school
   B. Remember that God made you special and tell a trusted adult if it continues
   C. Change your name
   D. Tease them back

2. What is joy, as a Christian understands it? (1 mark)
   A. A deep gladness that comes from knowing God loves us
   B. Having lots of money
   C. Never having problems
   D. Only laughing at jokes

3. What should you do before the day ends if you have quarrelled with a friend? (1 mark)
   A. Tell others lies about them
   B. Plan revenge
   C. Stop speaking to them
   D. Make peace and forgive

4. Which thought is likely to lead to a wrong action? (1 mark)
   A. I will help my friend
   B. I will share my lunch
   C. I want to take what is not mine
   D. I will thank my teacher

5. What should you say if someone tries to touch your private parts? (1 mark)
   A. Yes please
   B. Nothing
   C. No, stop!
   D. Thank you

6. Which of these is a safe touch? (1 mark)
   A. A touch you have been told to keep secret
   B. A touch that scares you
   C. Touching your private parts by a stranger
   D. A hug from a parent

7. Which verse says that there is no one holy like the Lord? (1 mark)
   A. Isaiah 49:16
   B. 1 Samuel 2:2
   C. Galatians 5:22
   D. Luke 1:37

8. Which group of books in the Old Testament is known as the Law? (1 mark)
   A. Genesis to Deuteronomy
   B. Job to Song of Songs
   C. Isaiah to Malachi
   D. Joshua to Esther

9. How many books are in the Old Testament? (1 mark)
   A. 66
   B. 39
   C. 12
   D. 27

10. Which word best describes a person who is honest even when nobody sees? (1 mark)
   A. Pride
   B. Greed
   C. Jealousy
   D. Integrity

11. In which town did Zacchaeus live? (1 mark)
   A. Nazareth
   B. Jericho
   C. Bethlehem
   D. Jerusalem

12. What did Jesus say about why He came? (1 mark)
   A. To build a palace
   B. To collect taxes
   C. To seek and to save the lost
   D. To rule Rome

13. Who asked Balaam to curse the Israelites? (1 mark)
   A. Joshua
   B. Pharaoh
   C. Herod
   D. King Balak

14. How can a child trust God when facing a challenge? (1 mark)
   A. Blame others
   B. Ignore the problem
   C. Give up
   D. Pray, read the Bible and ask for help from trusted people

15. What did God tell Abram to do? (1 mark)
   A. Go to Egypt
   B. Stay at home
   C. Leave his country and go to a land God would show him
   D. Build a boat

16. What was Abram's name changed to? (1 mark)
   A. Abraham
   B. Jacob
   C. Israel
   D. Isaac

17. Which angel appeared to Zechariah? (1 mark)
   A. Uriel
   B. Michael
   C. Raphael
   D. Gabriel

18. Which verse in Luke says that John would go before the Lord to prepare His way? (1 mark)
   A. Luke 7:14
   B. Luke 1:76
   C. Luke 19:5
   D. Luke 15:8

19. What did Bartimaeus do when Jesus called him? (1 mark)
   A. Threw his cloak aside and jumped up
   B. Stayed sitting
   C. Ran away
   D. Hid

20. Which Gospel records the healing of Bartimaeus? (1 mark)
   A. Genesis
   B. Romans
   C. Mark
   D. Acts

21. What did Jesus ask about the other nine? (1 mark)
   A. Why were they sick?
   B. Who healed them?
   C. Who are they?
   D. Where are the other nine?

22. What did Jesus say to the woman? (1 mark)
   A. Go home
   B. Give me water
   C. Don't cry
   D. Follow me

23. What did Joseph say about what his brothers intended? (1 mark)
   A. You are enemies
   B. You must leave
   C. You must pay
   D. You intended to harm me, but God intended it for good

24. Where is the parable of the lost coin found? (1 mark)
   A. Acts 2:38
   B. John 3:16
   C. Genesis 12:1
   D. Luke 15:8-10

25. What does the lost coin stand for? (1 mark)
   A. A house
   B. A rich man
   C. A lamp
   D. A person who has wandered from God

26. Who visited Jesus at night? (1 mark)
   A. Nicodemus
   B. Zacchaeus
   C. Balaam
   D. Samson

27. Why should we trust God always? (1 mark)
   A. He is unknown
   B. He forgets
   C. He is far
   D. He is loving and faithful

28. A stranger offers you a lift. What should you do? (1 mark)
   A. Go with them
   B. Give your name
   C. Say no and tell a trusted adult
   D. Accept

29. If a stranger tries to grab you, what should you do? (1 mark)
   A. Give them your bag
   B. Stay silent
   C. Shout for help and run to a safe place
   D. Go with them

30. Why does a truthful person feel peaceful? (1 mark)
   A. They are old
   B. They have nothing to hide
   C. They are popular
   D. They are rich

31. Which is a school rule? (1 mark)
   A. Skip lessons
   B. Litter
   C. Fight freely
   D. Arrive on time

32. What does obedience mean? (1 mark)
   A. Doing what you like
   B. Arguing
   C. Refusing rules
   D. Doing what those in authority say when it is good and right

33. Which action shows obedience to school rules? (1 mark)
   A. Leaving without permission
   B. Keeping the compound clean
   C. Coming late
   D. Fighting

34. What should you do with a found pencil that is not yours? (1 mark)
   A. Hand it to the teacher
   B. Keep it
   C. Throw it away
   D. Sell it

35. What does Acts 2:38 tell people to do? (1 mark)
   A. Sell everything
   B. Repent and be baptised
   C. Fast for a month
   D. Stay at home

36. Which disciple was a tax collector? (1 mark)
   A. Philip
   B. Andrew
   C. Peter
   D. Matthew

37. Which two disciples were brothers, sons of Zebedee? (1 mark)
   A. Thomas and Philip
   B. Peter and Andrew
   C. James and John
   D. Matthew and Thaddaeus

38. Which fruit means being gentle and careful with people's feelings? (1 mark)
   A. Envy
   B. Gentleness
   C. Pride
   D. Greed

39. What can help you to build self-control? (1 mark)
   A. Bad company
   B. Ignoring rules
   C. Being idle
   D. Keeping busy with good activities

40. What is a good way to limit screen time? (1 mark)
   A. Do your homework first and take breaks
   B. Watch all day
   C. Skip meals
   D. Never sleep

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Give two examples from the Bible of people who disobeyed God. (2 marks)

42. Explain how Jesus and Joseph are examples of forgiveness. (3 marks)

43. Give three ways of living a righteous life. (3 marks)

44. What is a mustard seed like, and what does it grow into? (2 marks)

45. Explain the two greatest commandments and how a child can obey them. (5 marks)

46. Describe three steps for making a right decision. (3 marks)

47. Explain what the parts of the parable stand for. (3 marks)

48. State two ways of respecting the church building. (2 marks)

49. Explain what Jesus taught in Matthew 5:38-39 and what this teaching does not mean. (5 marks)

50. State two ways of showing respect for the Bible. (2 marks)

51. Explain how the parable shows God's love for the sinner and how a child can respond. (5 marks)

52. Give three rules for staying safe from strangers. (3 marks)

53. Describe what a child should do step by step if someone touches them wrongly. (4 marks)

54. State two benefits of obeying parents. (2 marks)

55. Explain four reasons why children should honour their parents. (5 marks)

56. Name two people you can tell if you are touched in a way that makes you unsafe. (2 marks)

57. State two lessons from Joseph's response to temptation. (2 marks)

58. Explain why we should bless and not curse others. (3 marks)

59. Name two fruits of the Holy Spirit listed in Galatians 5:22-23. (2 marks)

60. Give two ways of helping a needy classmate. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #14 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Remember that God made you special and tell a trusted adult if it continues
   God's view of you matters more than unkind words.

2. A — A deep gladness that comes from knowing God loves us
   Christian joy is based on God's love, not on our circumstances.

3. D — Make peace and forgive
   Ephesians 4:26 says not to let the sun go down on your anger.

4. C — I want to take what is not mine
   Wanting to take what belongs to others leads to stealing.

5. C — No, stop!
   Say no loudly and clearly, then move away.

6. D — A hug from a parent
   A hug from a parent is safe and loving.

7. B — 1 Samuel 2:2
   1 Samuel 2:2 declares God's holiness.

8. A — Genesis to Deuteronomy
   The first five books are called the Law.

9. B — 39
   The Old Testament has 39 books.

10. D — Integrity
   Integrity means doing right when nobody is watching.

11. B — Jericho
   Luke 19:1 says Jesus was passing through Jericho.

12. C — To seek and to save the lost
   Luke 19:10 says that the Son of Man came to seek and save the lost.

13. D — King Balak
   Numbers 22 says that Balak, king of Moab, sent for Balaam.

14. D — Pray, read the Bible and ask for help from trusted people
   Trust in God shows in prayer and seeking help.

15. C — Leave his country and go to a land God would show him
   Genesis 12:1 records the call.

16. A — Abraham
   Genesis 17:5 records the new name.

17. D — Gabriel
   Gabriel said, "I stand in the presence of God."

18. B — Luke 1:76
   Luke 1:76-79 speaks about John's task.

19. A — Threw his cloak aside and jumped up
   He threw off his cloak and came to Jesus.

20. C — Mark
   Mark 10:46-52 tells the story.

21. D — Where are the other nine?
   Luke 17:17 records the question.

22. C — Don't cry
   Luke 7:13 records these words.

23. D — You intended to harm me, but God intended it for good
   Genesis 50:20 records this.

24. D — Luke 15:8-10
   The parable is in Luke 15:8-10.

25. D — A person who has wandered from God
   The coin stands for a lost person.

26. A — Nicodemus
   John 3:1-2 says Nicodemus came at night.

27. D — He is loving and faithful
   God is reliable.

28. C — Say no and tell a trusted adult
   Never go with strangers.

29. C — Shout for help and run to a safe place
   Shouting and running attract help.

30. B — They have nothing to hide
   Truth brings a clear conscience.

31. D — Arrive on time
   Being on time is a common school rule.

32. D — Doing what those in authority say when it is good and right
   Obedience means following good instructions.

33. B — Keeping the compound clean
   Following rules shows responsibility.

34. A — Hand it to the teacher
   Return what is not yours.

35. B — Repent and be baptised
   Peter's answer to the crowd.

36. D — Matthew
   Matthew was a tax collector.

37. C — James and John
   James and John were sons of Zebedee.

38. B — Gentleness
   Gentleness is caring.

39. D — Keeping busy with good activities
   Good activities help.

40. A — Do your homework first and take breaks
   Balance is important.

SECTION B
----
41. (2 marks)
   Answer: Adam and Eve, Jonah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each example.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: Jesus prayed for those who crucified Him. Joseph forgave his brothers and cared for them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Jesus, 1 for Joseph, 1 for what each did.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Tell the truth, obey parents, share, avoid bad company, say sorry, pray and read the Bible.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: A very small seed that grows into a large tree.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

45. (5 marks)
   Answer: Love God with all your heart, soul and mind, and love your neighbour as yourself. A child obeys by praying, reading the Bible, going to church, and by kindness, sharing and forgiving others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for loving God, 1 for loving neighbour, 1 for prayer or Bible, 1 for kindness, 1 for forgiving or sharing.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: Stop and think, ask if it pleases God, pray, ask advice, choose the right thing.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: The woman stands for God; the coin stands for a lost person; the joy stands for the joy in heaven when someone repents.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid part.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: Enter quietly, do not litter, keep phones silent, take care of Bibles.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

49. (5 marks)
   Answer: Jesus taught that we should not repay evil with evil but respond with peace. It does not mean we must stay in danger or let people harm us. If someone keeps hurting us, we should tell a trusted adult who will protect us.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for not repaying evil with evil, 1 for peace, 1 for not staying in danger, 1 for telling a trusted adult, 1 for a clear explanation.

50. (2 marks)
   Answer: Keep it clean, carry it carefully, keep it in a high safe place, wash hands before reading, do not write in it.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

51. (5 marks)
   Answer: God searches for lost people like the woman for her coin. He is happy when a person repents. A child can respond by saying sorry to God, turning away from wrong, living a righteous life, and caring for others who go astray.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God's search, 1 for God's joy, 1 for saying sorry, 1 for righteous living, 1 for caring for others.

52. (3 marks)
   Answer: Do not go with them, do not accept gifts or lifts, do not give personal details, shout for help, tell a trusted adult.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid rule.

53. (4 marks)
   Answer: Say no loudly, move away quickly to a safe place with people, shout for help if needed, tell a trusted adult right away even if told to keep it secret.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step, up to 4.

54. (2 marks)
   Answer: Pleases God, peace at home, trust from parents, learning good habits.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid benefit.

55. (5 marks)
   Answer: God commands it (Exodus 20:12); parents care for us; it brings peace at home; it brings God's blessing; it sets an example for younger children.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason up to 4, and 1 mark for a clear explanation.

56. (2 marks)
   Answer: Parent, guardian, teacher, pastor, nurse, police officer. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid person.

57. (2 marks)
   Answer: Say no clearly, run away, remember that sin is against God, stay faithful.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each lesson.

58. (3 marks)
   Answer: Words can build up or break down people. God wants us to love others. Blessing brings peace.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the power of words, 1 for God's wish for love, 1 for peace.

59. (2 marks)
   Answer: Any two of love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, self-control.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct fruit.

60. (2 marks)
   Answer: Share a pencil or lunch, help with a lesson, welcome them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.
